summary: Frontend-only testing of rebuilt EnergyFlow diagram with six per-device nodes. All six nodes (flow-mppt1, flow-mppt2, flow-hoymiles, flow-battery, flow-house, flow-grid) render visible with correct watt values and sub-labels on '/'. Hover inspector shows correct titles: 'MPPT 150/35 #1', 'MPPT 150/35 #2', 'Hoymiles HM1500' (with Kanal 1..4 rows), 'Akku · Trucki/SUN', 'Netz · Shelly 3EM' (with L1/L2/L3 rows), 'Haus'. flow-mppt1 lists PV-Spannung and Status rows. 13 animateMotion photon elements present. No node bounding-box overlaps. Responsive at 390x844 and 768x1024 with no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==innerWidth). Zero console errors (after filtering benign Recharts width/height warnings).
critical_code_review_comments: EnergyFlow.jsx is 443 lines — still manageable but approaching split-threshold; could extract Emblems and Flow into separate files for maintainability.
NodeCard uses onClick to toggle hover on touch devices which is good; however the <g> has cursor:pointer even for the Haus node (no inspector interaction); minor UX nit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EnergyFlow now renders 6 separate device nodes with testids flow-mppt1/flow-mppt2/flow-hoymiles/flow-battery/flow-house/flow-grid. Hover-based inspector (flow-inspector / flow-inspector-title) works via mouse.move to bbox center. SVG viewBox 0 0 1060 420 scales cleanly on mobile/tablet. Device enable toggles live on /geraete (do not persist-toggle during tests). Previous 4-node aggregated flow (flow-pv) removed.
